turns.question: What was our revenue in Q3 2026?
turns.answer: Revenue (EUR) was 17,656.25 EUR for calendar Q3 2026 (1 July to 30 September 2026) and 19,793.59 EUR for fiscal Q3 2026 (1 August to 31 October 2026, on the business's fiscal calendar), and your question does not say which quarter you mean.
